description: This file defines the MessageWrapper class, which wraps a Message object, providing additional functionality such as language scope adjustment and string representation for logging or debugging. It extends a superclass called Wrapper and implements the TemplateMappings interface.

classes.name: MessageWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps an IPC Message object, providing methods for language scope configuration and a string representation.

methods.name: MessageWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with a Message object, setting scope based on supported languages.

methods.name: getVariable
methods.description: Returns null as applicable for IPC messages.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string describing the message ID along with optional input and output parameter names.
